title: CISO ( Chief Information Security Officer) - B2B

details.jobDescription:
Location: Bucharest | 2 days/week with flexibility

Contract Type: B2B (PFA/SRL)

Daily rate: 40-50 euro/h

Position Overview:

As a CISO, you will report to the Head of IT Production and will play a critical role in safeguarding our organization’s information and technology assets.

You will drive together with our Product Development team the introduction and development of new IT security services and products delivered to our customers.

Responsibilities:

  • Develop and lead the information security program, ensuring the protection of IT assets, applications, systems, and technology.

  • Build and drive a comprehensive cybersecurity strategy and operating framework.

  • Implement secure processes and systems to prevent, detect, mitigate, and recover from cyberattacks.

  • Collaborate with CSO to manage technology risk effectively.

  • Collaborate with IT Architecture, Product Development and Sales Teams in developing IT security solutions to be delivered to our customers.

  • Continuously evaluate and manage the organization’s cyber and technology risk posture (including vulnerability management and IT lifecycle management).

  • Define and supervise business continuity IT procedures and processes.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or related field (Master’s preferred).

  • CISSP, CISM, or other relevant certification.

  • Proven experience as a CISO or senior security expert role.

  • Strong knowledge of cybersecurity principles, risk management, and compliance.

  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
